text:
ella: Quick red flag from the weekly KPI — webinars + launch posts boosted traffic but MQLs flat. Need a short triage before Friday's readout.
mike: Which tile shows the gap?
ella: Conversion funnel tile (sessions -> demo_request). Sessions +380%, demo_request +1.8%.
priya: Could be messaging mismatch (social vs site copy) or lost UTMs. We used three shortlinks for IG/TikTok.
jamal: I noticed several sessions labeled 'social' with no utm_campaign. Shortlink service might be stripping query strings.
ops-bot: shortlinks v2 rolled at 08:42 UTC (sha: b7c9e). Config: preserve_qs=false.
priya: That would explain it. Action: flip preserve_qs, run backfill for last 48h clicks, and add an unattributed metric to the KPI dashboard.
mike: Also check messaging variant performance — our IG copy was headline-first vs the page which is product-first. Could be mismatch lowering demo intent.
priya: Good call. I'll pull the messaging cohort by referral and compare demo_request rates.
jamal: Quick SQL to check utm coverage:
```
select count(*) filter (where utm_source is null) as no_utm, count(*) as total from sessions where occurred_at > now() - interval '48 hours';
```
Result: no_utm = 5,120 / total = 19,600 (~26%).
analytics-bot: Added metric "unattributed_pct" to KPI dashboard and set alert at 20%.
ops-bot: PR: https://git.company/shortener/pull/501  set preserve_qs=true. Canary deploy running.
priya: Backfill plan: link click logs -> session_id match, expected recovery ~65%. I'll run job and post snapshots pre/post for the weekly deck. ETA 4h.
mike: If backfill recovers demos, we annotate the KPI slide with the tracking note and avoid a big product deep-dive. If not, we'll run a quick A/B on landing headline + CTA.
ella: Thanks — keep this thread as the single source. Please post pre/post dashboard images and a 1-2 line summary for exec slide. :eyes:
